reason: JSON.parse throws on malformed NDJSON lines and has no non-throwing form. The catch returns undefined so one corrupt debug log line falls back to raw display instead of crashing /logs or the Runtime Logs widget.

statSync and readFileSync throw on unreadable, vanished, or non-file debug log paths. Returning undefined degrades /logs and the 1s Runtime Logs widget to an empty preview instead of crashing the TUI.
